_comment: Display metadata for every plugin under plugins/: the store shows name, description, category, tags and status from here. release.yml and scripts/release-all.sh read it when packaging; registry.json is generated from it and never edited by hand.

agent.name: Agent
agent.description: Multi-step goal loop: plans a natural-language goal and calls other plugins' actions as tools, with long-term memory on vector-db.

ai.name: AI
ai.description: Provider-agnostic LLM chat completion, embeddings and vision (Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, Ollama) routed through network.

automations.name: Automations
automations.description: Declarative trigger → conditions → action rules over kernel events, with cooldowns and a confirmation gate.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: Event CRUD with reminders, recurrence and ICS import/export, stored in database.

capture.name: Capture
capture.description: Screenshots, screen recording and local OCR over PipeWire and tesseract.

chats.name: Chats
chats.description: Shared conversation history for every device: sessions, turns, full-text search and revision-based sync.

clipboard.name: Clipboard
clipboard.description: Read and write the system clipboard (Wayland/X11) with history.

contacts.name: Contacts
contacts.description: Contact store (name, email, phone, tags) as a thin schema over database.

daemon.name: Voice Daemon
daemon.description: Headless always-on voice client: mic → stt → agent → tts → speakers, with VAD and push-to-talk modes.

database.name: Database
database.description: Per-caller SQLite KV and SQL storage with TTLs, counters and change events.

email.name: Email
email.description: Send mail over SMTP and list IMAP mailboxes, with vault-first credentials.

filesystem.name: Filesystem
filesystem.description: Sandboxed file browse/read/write/move/delete behind an allowlist of roots.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: List and create issues, list pull requests and CI runs through the GitHub REST API.

hotkey.name: Hotkey
hotkey.description: Global key combos to kernel events via the XDG GlobalShortcuts portal — push-to-talk and shortcuts.

launcher.name: Launcher
launcher.description: Launch desktop apps and Steam games by name.

library.name: Library
library.description: Index local music, photos and video under allowlisted roots for search and random picks.

media.name: Media
media.description: Control MPRIS players and per-app audio streams: play/pause/seek/volume/shuffle/loop.

metrics.name: Metrics
metrics.description: Periodic CPU/RAM/disk/battery samples with range queries for graphs.

mic.name: Microphone
mic.description: Microphone capture primitive streaming PCM frames to a target plugin.

mqtt.name: MQTT
mqtt.description: MQTT client with device registry, telemetry and OTA for Tasmota/ESPHome/Zigbee2MQTT-style devices.

network.name: Network
network.description: SSRF-guarded outbound HTTP for every other plugin, with compression, multipart, caching and cookies.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Note CRUD with search as a thin schema over database.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Desktop notifications, spoken alerts, a silent inbox and ntfy/Gotify phone push.

phone.name: Phone
phone.description: Window-less camera (photo and live stream) on an Ubuntu Touch phone over ssh or locally, via a libhybris helper.

rss.name: RSS
rss.description: Subscribe to RSS/Atom feeds, fetch and query deduplicated articles.

scheduler.name: Scheduler
scheduler.description: One-shot and cron schedules (IANA time zones) that publish events or call actions.

search.name: Search
search.description: Web search through Brave or Tavily with vault-first API keys.

secrets.name: Secrets
secrets.description: Encrypted per-caller credential and API-key vault (ChaCha20-Poly1305).

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: Audio output primitive — plays files or inline audio as the single owner of the speakers.

speech.name: Speech
speech.description: Text-to-speech and speech-to-text in one process: local ONNX (Kokoro/Piper/Zipformer/Whisper) plus cloud providers.

stt.name: STT (legacy)
stt.description: Standalone speech-to-text — superseded by the speech plugin; kept for existing installs.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Host-side versioned KV state that publishes a delta event on every change.

sync-client.name: Sync Client
sync-client.description: Client-side mirror of the host sync store with a heartbeat.

system.name: System
system.description: Host info and reversible controls: battery, processes, volume, brightness, lock, power profile.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.description: To-do list with due dates, lists and tags as a thin schema over database.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.description: Telegram user-account client: dialogs, history, search, send/edit/forward, media and voice.

tts.name: TTS (legacy)
tts.description: Standalone text-to-speech — superseded by the speech plugin; kept for existing installs.

uptime.name: Uptime
uptime.description: Periodic URL health checks with history and failure events for alerting.

vector-db.name: Vector DB
vector-db.description: Per-caller embedding store with cosine similarity search.

weather.name: Weather
weather.description: Current weather and daily forecast from Open-Meteo — no API key.
